title: 第9章 开棺第10章 墨斗绳绑棺材还是用麻绳吧
content_zh:
……
经过几个壮汉一番脚踹墓碑、手拆墓门等粗暴操作后，坟坑里已经能看见棺材的一角了！
“看见了！”
挖坟的人见棺材露出，大喊了一声，然后给棺材套上麻绳滑轮，几个人齐心协力将棺材拽了出来。
等棺材放置稳定后，九叔沉声吩咐道、
“准备好，松绳、起钉，开棺！”
趁着几名帮工给棺材起钉的间隙，九叔让众人离棺材远些，然后沉声道。
“诸位！今天是任公威勇重见天日，凡年龄二十二、三十五、三十六还有四十八，属鸡属牛者，一律转身回避！”
待需要回避的人都转身回避后，九叔点点头，来到棺材前。
看着已经起钉的棺材，九叔眼睛眯了起来，神色也渐渐凝重起来。
这棺材不太对劲啊！笼罩着一层黑漆漆的煞气，像是藏着什么大凶之物一般。
“回避完成，大家整理衣物，开棺！”
嘎吱……嘎吱……嘎吱……
随着一阵刺耳的嘎吱嘎吱过后，任老太爷的棺材盖被打开了，棺材里面冒出一股浓重的黑雾。
于此同时，周围的树林里成片的乌鸦飞起，伴随着嘎嘎嘎的鸟叫声，四散飞开！
“师父，煞气冲天，恐怕会起尸啊！”
林道然走到九叔身旁，取出一张驱邪符将棺材冒出的黑雾驱散了，开口对九叔说。
“等下看看尸体的情况，再跟任老爷商量下解决的方法！”
九叔眉头紧皱，他要先看看尸体才能决定下一步该怎么做。
在看清楚棺材里栩栩如生的尸体后，众人都倒吸了一口凉气。下葬二十年，没有腐烂成白骨，只是皮肉干瘪，面目铁青！而且这皮肉自开棺后还慢慢地鼓胀起来！这谁看了谁不倒吸凉气啊！

“爹！”
“爷爷！”
任发和任婷婷见到尸体的瞬间就跪下磕头了。
“爹啊，惊动了你老人家，孩儿真是不孝啊！”
挤出了几滴眼泪，磕完三个头后，在村民们面前装完了孝子的任发，站了起来向九叔问道。
“九叔，这个蜻蜓点水穴还能用吗？”
九叔摇了摇头，沉声道：“蜻蜓点水，一点再点，肯定不会点在同一个穴位上，这个穴没用了。而且结合刚才的异象，任老爷，我建议就地火化吧！”
“火化！不行！家父生前最惧怕的就是火了，要是将其火化了，那我岂不是成了不孝之人，我不能这样做！九叔，你还是想想其他的方法吧！”
任发听后脸都绿了，将头摇成了拨浪鼓！本来就害父亲在这里受了二十年的苦，如果现在一挖出来，还没安置好就把他给烧了，这传出去，其他人将如何看他，他任家的名声也就没了。到时候，谁还会和任家做生意！
听着任发的决定，九叔也想到了问题所在。
这年头可不流行火化，连普通百姓都是力求入土为安的，谁敢烧他先人的尸体，他可是会跟你拼命的！更不用说任家这样的大户了！尸体一烧，名声也就没了！
“好吧！任老爷，那不如先把任老太爷安置在义庄吧！待过几天找到墓穴了，再将其迁葬过去！”
九叔琢磨了一会，只能无可奈何的让帮工将棺材扛回了义庄。
“九叔，有劳了！那麻烦你尽快地帮先父找到一块宝穴吧！”
任发看了看棺材，点了点头，叹息道。
content_en:
…
After a few strong men kicked the tombstone and removed the tomb door with their hands and other rough operations, a corner of the coffin could already be seen in the grave!
"Saw it!"
When the grave digger saw the coffin exposed, he shouted, then put a hemp rope pulley on the coffin, and several people worked together to pull the coffin out.
After the coffin was placed stably, Uncle Jiu said in a deep voice,
"Get ready, loosen the ropes, remove the nails, and open the coffin!"
While several helpers were removing the nails from the coffin, Uncle Jiu asked everyone to stay away from the coffin, and then said in a deep voice.
"Everyone! Today is the day when Mr. Ren is brave enough to see the light of day again. Anyone who is twenty-two, thirty-five, thirty-six, or forty-eight years old and born in the Year of the Rooster or Ox must turn around and avoid it!"
After everyone who needed to be avoided turned around, Uncle Jiu nodded and came to the coffin.
Looking at the coffin that had already been nailed, Uncle Jiu narrowed his eyes and his expression gradually became serious.
There's something wrong with this coffin! There was a layer of dark evil aura, as if something dangerous was hidden.
"Evasion completed, everyone packs clothes and opens the coffin!"
Crunch...crunch...crunch...
After a harsh creaking, the lid of Old Man Ren's coffin was opened, and a thick black mist came out of the coffin.
At the same time, swarms of crows flew up in the surrounding woods, scattering in all directions along with the chirping of birds!
"Master, the evil spirit is so strong that I'm afraid the corpse will be raised!"
Lin Daoran walked to Uncle Jiu, took out an exorcism charm to disperse the black mist from the coffin, and spoke to Uncle Jiu.
"Wait to see the condition of the body, and then discuss the solution with Master Ren!"
Uncle Jiu frowned. He wanted to see the body first before he could decide what to do next.
After seeing the lifelike corpse in the coffin, everyone took a breath. After being buried for twenty years, he did not rot into bones, but his skin and flesh were shriveled and his face was ashen! Moreover, the flesh has slowly swelled since the coffin was opened! Who doesn’t take a breath after seeing this?
"Dad!"
"Grandpa!"
Ren Fa and Ren Tingting knelt down and kowtowed the moment they saw the corpse.
"Dad, I have alarmed your old man. The child is really unfilial!"
After squeezing out a few tears and kowtowing three times, Ren Fa, who had finished pretending to be a filial son in front of the villagers, stood up and asked Uncle Jiu.
"Uncle Jiu, can this dragonfly point water hole still be used?"
Uncle Jiu shook his head and said in a deep voice: "Dry the water with a dragonfly, a little after a little. It will definitely not be on the same acupoint. This acupoint will be useless. And based on the vision just now, Master Ren, I suggest that you be cremated on the spot!"
"Cremation! No! What my father feared most during his lifetime was fire. If he was cremated, wouldn't I become an unfilial person? I can't do this! Uncle Jiu, you should think of other ways!"
Ren Fa's face turned green after hearing this, and he shook his head like a rattle! My father had suffered here for twenty years. If he was dug out and burned before he could be resettled, how would other people view him if word spread, and the reputation of his family would be ruined. At that time, who will do business with the Ren family!
Listening to Ren Fa's decision, Uncle Jiu also thought of the problem.
Cremation is not popular these days. Even ordinary people strive to be buried in peace. Whoever dares to burn the corpse of his ancestor will fight you to the death! Not to mention a big family like the Ren family! Once the body is burned, the reputation will be gone!
"Okay! Master Ren, let's place Mr. Ren in Yizhuang first! After we find the tomb in a few days, we can move him there!"
Uncle Jiu thought about it for a while and had no choice but to let the helpers carry the coffin back to Yizhuang.
"Uncle Ninth, thank you for your work! Then please help my late father find a treasure cave as soon as possible!"
Ren Fa looked at the coffin, nodded, and sighed.
